# Social Surge

> Social Surge DM LTD is a UK-based, PPC-only digital marketing agency in Bristol that scales e-commerce brands through Google Ads, Meta Ads and managed AI performance infrastructure. 18.3x average ROAS across the client base, 100% ad account transparency, weekly reporting, rolling monthly agreements, no long-term contracts.

## Who we are

- **Company:** Social Surge DM LTD, Bristol, United Kingdom
- **Focus:** Pay-per-click (PPC) advertising for UK e-commerce retailers, nothing else
- **Niches:** Cycling, fishing and outdoor/hobbyist e-commerce, plus broader UK online retail
- **Contact:** hello@social-surge.co.uk · +44 7796 374 758
- **Website:** https://social-surge.co.uk/

## Services

- **Google Ads Management** (from £1,500/month): Search, Shopping and Performance Max for e-commerce, feed optimisation, product-level exclusions, tROAS bidding, weekly reporting. https://social-surge.co.uk/services/google-ads-management/
- **Meta Ads Management** (from £1,000/month): Facebook & Instagram ads with creative testing, Conversions API tracking and disciplined scaling. https://social-surge.co.uk/services/meta-ads-management/
- **AI Performance Infrastructure**: a managed intelligence layer that continuously analyses ad accounts, anomaly detection, product performance analysis, budget signals, automated reporting. https://social-surge.co.uk/services/ai-performance-infrastructure/
- **Free PPC Audit**: full account review (tracking, wasted spend, structure, opportunities), no obligation. https://social-surge.co.uk/audit/
- Combined Google + Meta management from £2,250/month. Full pricing: https://social-surge.co.uk/pricing/

## Verified results

- £1.62M revenue in 92 days (Black Friday-February, UK e-commerce retailer): https://social-surge.co.uk/case-studies/1-6m-revenue-92-days/
- £2.5M revenue growth in 12 months; £4.3M record year after rebuilding a Search-only account with Shopping and Performance Max: https://social-surge.co.uk/case-studies/2-5m-growth-12-months/
- 144% more conversions on 16% less spend via tracking fixes, waste removal and restructuring: https://social-surge.co.uk/case-studies/144-percent-more-conversions/
- +23.6% YoY revenue on +5.6% spend for a UK cycling retailer; 304 zero-conversion products excluded, Shopping ROAS 12.09x → 16.20x, AOV £33.41 → £51.72: https://social-surge.co.uk/case-studies/ai-infrastructure-performance/

## Why clients choose Social Surge

- PPC-only specialisation (no generalist dilution)
- 100% ad account transparency, clients own their accounts and data
- Flat published fees, rolling monthly agreements, no lock-ins
- Weekly revenue-first reporting (ROAS, CPA, conversion value)
- Proprietary AI performance infrastructure for catalogue-scale analysis
